rows.section: A NEW STARTER CAN SIGN IN
rows.text: NS Signing in as them opens the onboarding portal and nothing else
NB The board is seeded from the loaded tenant
NB Three capabilities sit in the permission matrix
NB Only an admin may post to everyone by default
NB Notice posted is an event on the notification framework
NB Notice board is listed under Workforce core features
NB My team → Notices renders for a manager
NB A manager can target only their own location and departments within it
NB Posting creates a live record scoped to that location
NB ... with a new, unique identifier
NB ... and colleagues are told through the framework
NB ... and the posting is audited, draft → live
NB A manager posting to Everyone is refused in the action layer and nothing is created
NB The demo employee works where the manager posted, so the reader checks run
NB My work → Notices lists the location notice for someone there
NB The audience is only people at that location
NB The employee can be moved to another location
NB After the move the old location’s notice is gone from their list
NB ... and the notice itself did not change
NB ... and moving them back restores it
NB The Home card offers the notice for acknowledgement
NB Acknowledging writes one record at the current version
NB Acknowledging twice adds nothing
NB The acknowledgement is audited
NB The tracker shows who acknowledged which version
NB Editing warns how many will be asked again
NB The audience cannot change once live
NB The edit is v2 and v1 is kept in history
NB The v1 acknowledgement stays on record
NB ... but it does not count for v2
NB The colleague is told it changed and asked again
NB The edit is audited v1 → v2
NB Pinning does not make a new version
NB A live notice cannot be deleted
NB ... and the refusal says to withdraw it instead
NB The seeded draft is in the manager’s scope
NB A draft can be deleted
NB ... and the deletion is audited
NB Withdrawing without a reason is refused and it stays live
NB With a reason it is withdrawn and the reason is kept
NB ... its acknowledgements survive
NB ... it stays on the poster’s list
NB ... colleagues no longer see it
NB ... and the withdrawal is audited with its reason
NB A notice past its end date is under Expired
NB ... and not under Current
NB ... nor on the Home card
NB With the flag off there is no Notices tab and no Home card
NB ... and the notices are kept
NB Turning it back on restores the tab
NB Revoking own_notices for employees is recorded
NB ... the tab is gone
NB ... and Acknowledge is refused in the action layer
NB Granting it back restores it
NB An admin can post to Everyone
NB Save draft keeps it as a draft
NB ... that nobody sees
NB Posting the draft makes it live
NB ... for everyone
NB A notice starting later is live but shown to posters as Scheduled
NB ... and colleagues do not see it before its start date
